text:
mira: heads up — after last telemetry proxy rollout i'm seeing a spike in slow renders for the dashboard charts (LCP/frames dropped). users reporting main-thread stalls when opening large heatmaps.

dan: saw a few alerts earlier, was going to ping. are these from canary or prod?

mira: mostly prod 2xx routes. canary looked fine initially but prod has a sustained 15% p99 latency bump for chart paint.

sylvie: any correlation with bundle size or new chunking? build logs show the client split changed yesterday.

mira: yes bundle gzipped +7%, main chunk parse time up. but the repaint happens even when bundle is cached — looks like runtime/telemetry init is blocking.

ben: deploy-bot: canary-deploy 1718501200 -> SUCCESS (telemetry-proxy v2.4.1) :white_check_mark:

ben: i'm wondering if telemetry sampler default changed. if telemetry now eagerly hydrates the sampling table on main thread that could explain parse/blocking.

sylvie: good point. mira can you grab a flame from the slow page? stack shows time in telemetry.init -> parseEvents -> registerSampler.

mira: attaching snippet from flame (trimmed):
```
MainThread
  - parseScripts (120ms)
  - telemetry.init (80ms)
    - registerSampler (60ms)
    - attachHooks (15ms)
```

mira: looks like registerSampler does a sync read of a ~40kb manifest and then some config parsing.

dan: do we still fetch telemetry manifest inline or via XHR?

sylvie: we moved to inline at build-time to avoid extra requests, but that increases parse cost. previously it was lazy XHR.

ben: quick mitigation: toggle telemetry.lazy_init = true for prod routes so sampler doesn't block initial paint. that should cut p99 paint by a lot.

mira: +1. we should also consider moving the manifest into a worker or using structured clone + postMessage.

dan: can we feature-flag the change and roll out to a small percentage?

sylvie: yes, roll via routing policy: route-weight 5% -> telemetry.lazy_init=true, monitor LCP and bundle parse.

mira: i'll patch the runtime config in the console rollout and start 5% canary now.

ben: small follow-up: re-check KV prefetch interaction — if KV prefetch is synchronous with telemetry init we'll still see stalls. we need to ensure prefetch happens after first paint.

mira: noted. i'll add a deferred prefetch toggle too.

dan: sounds good. steps: 1) mira deploy candidate with lazy_init + deferred prefetch (5%). 2) watch p95/p99 LCP, chart frames. 3) rollback if error spike.

sylvie: also i'll open a quick perf ticket to plan moving manifest off-main-thread.

mira: doing the deploy now. will post results in ~15m.

deploy-bot: rollout-started 1718504620 -> target: 5% of prod routes (telemetry.lazy_init=true)

mira: 15m update: canary showing ~35% reduction in p99 chart paint; main chunk parse still slightly up but rendering improved. starting gradual ramp to 25% while we validate.

ben: great. i'll follow up on making KV prefetch truly async (post-first-paint).

dan: thanks team — good triage. we should plan a non-blocking manifest plan in the next sprint.

sylvie: filing the follow-up ticket: PERF-894 "Telemetry manifest off-main-thread + async KV prefetch" and assigning to infra/perf.

mira: closing this thread once ramp passes 25% or we have rollback. anyone else see anything odd?

ben: nothing else, will update PR for deferred prefetch.
_annotation: generated slack thread about console frontend perf regression and rollout mitigation
